ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high contrast; pixels are heavily binarized between maximum intensity white (ventral field) and minimum intensity black (perimeter and markings). Approximately 80% white to 20% black ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Discrete black pixel clusters are localized on the upper-left lobe and as linear streaks on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 62 degrees, showing significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Relatively smooth topography with minor low-amplitude serrations (less than 5 pixels in depth) appearing more frequently on the outer third of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark pixel clusters on the distal tip of the left lobe and near the insertion point at the peduncle.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four distinct, roughly parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal rake marks on the right lobe; irregular pixel-loss on the far-left distal edge suggesting minor trailing edge trauma.
